name: Failures
overview: Scripture acknowledges that failure is an inevitable part of the believer's journey, as the righteous may fall multiple times but are upheld and given strength by God. The psalmist affirms that though the flesh and heart may fail, God remains the enduring strength and support. The Lord not only orders the steps of the godly but also raises up those who fall and are bowed down. True restoration comes through confessing and forsaking sins, which leads to mercy, highlighting the hope of rising again after failure rather than remaining in defeat.
